name: Chatterbox
description: Resemble AI's Chatterbox (MIT) behind an OpenAI-compatible speech API — 23 languages; a reference voice in another language lends its accent.

options.label: Language
options.description: The language to speak. Blank: the line's language (else the server guesses from the text).

options.label: Accent of the reference voice (cfg_weight)
options.description: With a reference voice recorded in another language, 0.5 keeps that language's accent and 0 removes it. Lower values also slow the pace.

options.label: Expressiveness (exaggeration)
options.description: 0.5 is neutral; higher is more emotional and usually faster.

options.label: Variation (temperature)
options.description: Higher: a more varied delivery; lower: steadier.

options.label: Seed
options.description: The same seed gives the same rendition. Blank: different each time.
